Theorem
[adjoint heat-kernel parametrix] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0364 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-adjoint-heat-kernel 1. ch16:16.46\group Perelman Harnack

On a smooth Ricci flow, the adjoint heat kernel has the local expansion \[ H(x,y,\tau )=(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-d_{g(0)}(x,y)^2/(4\tau )} (u_0(x,y,0)+O(\tau )),\qquad u_0(x,x,0)=1. \]
